meta.parties: Tikiri Bandara, W.R.W.M. v. Gunawardena, P

rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift, which is stated to be irrevocable and the clause containing irrevocability is not dependent on any condition, cannot be revoked.
rules.supporting_quote: "If in a Kandyan deed of gift it is stated that the deed is irrevocable and the clause containing irrevocability is not dependent on any condition, then such a deed cannot be revoked."
